goal_given_to_reviewer: Someone mentioned this S&P 500 fund to you. You opened its page to understand what it is and decide whether it is worth looking into further.

keys.where: the row of section names under the fund's header (Overview, Chart, Basics, Holdings, Performance and more)
keys.problem: The row of section names looks like tabs that switch what is shown, but each one scrolls the page down to a section of the same long page; the jump is unexpected, and afterwards the row is no longer where it was, so going back means finding it again.
The page is light, white; he prefers a dark page.
The page does not look very modern or polished (minor).
The performance section is plain and basic.

liked.what: The most important facts about the fund (yearly cost, distribution policy, fund size) are at the top centre.
The price chart: the time ranges right under it, green above 0% and red below, and the chosen range highlighted.
More advanced information further down, in the basics section; the page is detailed.
The holdings section: easy to reach and easy to understand.
A ? mark beside terms such as the yearly cost, distribution policy and replication, explaining them.
